# Reo.Dev - Developer-Focused Sales & Marketing Platform

## About
Reo.dev is a developer Marketing and GTM Revenue Intelligence Platform. Reo.dev provides developer intent signals across GitHub, dcoumentation, package managers, code interactions, website and product page interactions, and forum conversations. Reo.dev provides AI powered aggregation of thousands of developers activity signals into a coherent account-level narrative to enable GTM teams to identify high-fit accounts and outreach with timing and context.

## Key Features
- Developer-Intent Signals: Reo.Dev’s AI turns GitHub activity, docs engagement, product actions, website visits and more into revenue signals for developer marketing and GTM teams
- Sign-Up Deanonymization: Identify valuable developers behind anonymous sign-ups. GitHub and documentation activity. Prioritize GTM with the right developers at the right companies 
- Account Intel: Find accounts evaluating your product and prioritize outreach using AI-powered developer intent signals for faster conversion
- Buyer Prediction: Identify key buyers and practitioners within each target account using title and domain context to boost conversion rates.
- List Enrichment: Upload lists of GitHub IDs or email IDs to Reo.dev and enrich with complete developer profiles and firmographic data.
- Developer Audience Building: Create high-fit developer audiences by role, skill, and seniority—then enrich with real-time intent signals for sharper targeting.
- Technographics: Filter companies and build lists by tech stack and developer skills to run personalized outbound and ad campaigns that resonate
- Segments: Build hyper-targeted segments using 50+ filters across firmographics and developer behavior for smarter GTM campaigns.
- Developer Funnel: Visualize each account’s buyer journey to separate researchers from sales-ready leads and engage at the perfect moment.
- List Prioritization: Focus on high-intent accounts by enriching existing lists with developer signals—so your team spends time on what really matters
- Campaign Management: Automate campaigns, accelerate outreach, track performance with reo.dev’s integrations with Apollo, salesloft, outreach.io and more.
- Developer Community Listening: Monitor dev conversations across forums and Slack communities to uncover trends, sharpen messaging, and create campaigns
- Job Changes Tracking: Accelerate active opportunities and open new leads by tracking champions who shift jobs and can open doors for your developer GTM activities

## Use Cases
- Developer tool companies seeking qualified leads
- Developer tool companies seeking to build qualified pipeline based on real developer activity 
- B2B SaaS platforms targeting engineering teams
- Open source projects monetizing through enterprise sales
- Aggregating product usage into accounts and then identifying those who are ready to buy.
- Track developer evaluation at the though the course of a sales conversation
- Aggregate developer activity and reveal accounts who are testing your product before they start talking to sales
- Build a rich developer tool Account Based Marketing program based on actual developer usage of your product.  
- Support developer PLG products with well-timed and contextual sales outreach. 
- Convert open source interest into enterprise sales by identifying accounts using open source projects across distributed developer teams.  

## Personas
- Sales Development: Automated prospecting for developer-focused sales teams
- Marketing: Developer-specific campaign targeting and attribution
- RevOps: Pipeline optimization for technical product sales

# Reo.Dev API Documentation


## API Overview
- [API Documentation](https://developers.reo.dev/): Complete API reference for accessing Reo.Dev's developer intelligence data, including account information, developer profiles, and activity tracking.
- [Authentication](https://developers.reo.dev/#section/Authentication): Learn how to authenticate API requests using API keys and secure access to Reo.Dev endpoints.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://developers.reo.dev/): Download the complete OpenAPI specification for automated integration and SDK generation.

## Segments API
- [Get All Segments](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-all-segments): Retrieve a paginated list of all segments (account, developer, or buyer segments) with their names, IDs, types, and descriptions.
- [Get Accounts in Segment](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-accounts-in-segment): Fetch all accounts within a specific account segment, including company details, developer activity levels, and customer fit scores.
- [Get Developers in Segment](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-developers-in-segment): Access developer profiles within a developer segment, including names, emails, activity dates, and assigned tags.
- [Get Buyers in Segment](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-buyers-in-segment): Retrieve buyer profiles from buyer segments with contact information, activity history, and purchase intent indicators.

## Accounts API
- [Get Account Activities](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-account-activities): Access detailed activity logs for a specific account, including developer actions, engagement sources, and behavioral data.
- [Get Account Developers](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-account-developers): Fetch all developers associated with a specific account, including their profiles, activity levels, and engagement timeline.

## Developers API
- [Get Developer Activities](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-developer-activities): Retrieve comprehensive activity history for individual developers, including code interactions, engagement events, and behavioral patterns.

## Lists API
- [Create List](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/create-list): Create new custom lists for organizing accounts or developers with configurable field mappings and data structure definitions.
- [Get All Lists](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-all-lists): Retrieve all custom lists created by your organization, including list metadata, types, and configuration details.
- [Add Data to List](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/add-data-to-list): Add accounts or developers to existing lists with bulk upload support (up to 1000 entities per request) and custom field mapping.

## Audiences API
- [Get All Audiences](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-all-audiences): Access all configured audiences with filtering criteria, count metrics, credit consumption, and sync status information.
- [Get Audience Members](https://developers.reo.dev/#operation/get-audience-members): Retrieve paginated member lists from specific audiences, including contact details, CRM sync status, and profile verification data.

## API Features
### Authentication
- **API Key Authentication**: Secure access using unique API keys passed in the `x-api-key` header for all requests.
- **Per-Client Keys**: Each integration receives a unique API key for isolated access and usage tracking.
### Data Access
- **Account Intelligence**: Access company profiles, developer activity levels, customer fit scores, and engagement metrics.
- **Developer Profiles**: Retrieve individual developer information, activity history, and behavioral insights.
- **Activity Tracking**: Monitor real-time developer actions across documentation, products, and community platforms.
- **Segmentation**: Access pre-built and custom segments for targeted outreach and analysis.
### Response Format
- **Consistent JSON**: All endpoints return structured JSON responses with standardized data formats.
- **Pagination Support**: Large datasets are paginated with page numbers, total pages, and next page indicators.
- **Request Tracking**: Every response includes a unique `request_id` for debugging and support purposes.
### Rate Limits & Usage
- **Bulk Operations**: Support for bulk data operations with up to 1000 entities per request for list management.
- **Credit System**: Audience generation and data enrichment operations consume credits based on usage.
- **Real-time Data**: Access to live developer activity data and up-to-date profile information.

## Integration Patterns
### CRM Integration
- **Account Enrichment**: Enhance CRM records with developer activity scores, technology stack data, and engagement metrics.
- **Lead Scoring**: Integrate buyer prediction scores and developer intent signals into existing lead qualification workflows.
- **Activity Sync**: Automatically sync developer activities and engagement events to CRM platforms.
### Marketing Automation
- **Audience Building**: Create targeted marketing lists based on developer behavior, technology usage, and engagement levels.
- **Campaign Targeting**: Use segment data to build highly targeted campaigns for developer audiences.
- **Attribution**: Track developer journey from initial engagement through conversion using activity data.
### Sales Enablement
- **Prospect Research**: Access comprehensive developer profiles and company intelligence for sales preparation.
- **Intent Monitoring**: Real-time alerts on high-intent developer activities and engagement spikes.
- **Account Planning**: Use account-level developer activity and team composition data for strategic planning.
